items.exampleEn: The kids are playing in the yard.
My mother grows flowers in the garden.
Dad is cooking in the kitchen.
My father keeps his tools in a box.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸把他的工具放在一個箱子裡。

items.sentenceEn: My bedroom is at the end of the hall.
items.sentenceZh: 我的臥室在走廊的盡頭。

items.audioEn: I am in the garden. Can you bring me some tools?
items.audioZh: 我在花園裡，你可以拿一些工具給我嗎？

items.sentenceEn: We have a small yard behind the house.
items.sentenceZh: 我們房子後面有一個小院子。

items.stemEn: I use a ____ to open the door.

items.passageEn: We have a new house. It has three bedrooms and a big kitchen. My mother loves the kitchen because it has a new coffee machine. Behind the house, there is a yard with a small garden. My father keeps his tools there.
items.passageZh: 我們有一棟新房子，有三間臥室和一間大廚房。我媽媽很喜歡廚房，因為裡面有一台新的咖啡機。房子後面有一個院子，院子裡有一座小花園。我爸爸把他的工具放在那裡。

referenceEn: My key is in the bedroom.
My keys are in the bedroom.
rubricZh: 「在⋯裡」用 in（例如 in the bedroom、in my bedroom）
鑰匙可寫單數 key（配 is）或複數 keys（配 are）

items.instructionZh: 用 kitchen 造一個句子，說說你家的廚房，或你在廚房做什麼。
referenceEn: I cook in the kitchen every night.
Our kitchen is small but clean.
rubricZh: kitchen 前面加冠詞或所有格（例如 in the kitchen、a small kitchen、our kitchen）
動詞配合主詞（例如 I cook、Our kitchen is、We have）
